    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ArchiveSource
    Random access to the bytes of the outer runner archive.
    BuildLogger
    Where the packaging library reports what it did and what looked wrong.
    BuildLogger.NoOp
    The logger BuildLogger.noOp() hands out.
    BuildLogger.SystemErr
    The logger BuildLogger.systemErr() hands out, which prefixes every line so that the origin of a message is obvious in a build log it shares with everything else.
    Compression
    How a dependency is stored inside the runner jar.
    Dependency
    One dependency jar to nest into the runner jar, together with the coordinates it was resolved from.
    Entry
    The application entry point, as seen by the launcher.
    EntryStubGenerator
    Generates the class that lets the launcher start the application through an interface call.
    Extract
    The extract mode: turns a runner jar into an ordinary Main-Class plus Class-Path layout that the JDK's own application class loader runs.
    Handler
    The jar: protocol handler of a runner application.
    Handlers
    The jar: URL machinery of a runner jar: it owns the registration of Handler, the state that handler serves, and the construction of every URL the class loader hands out.
    Index
    The reader of MICRONAUT-INF/index.bin, the table of contents a runner jar carries so that the launcher never parses a nested archive at startup.
    IndexFormat
    The on-disk layout of MICRONAUT-INF/index.bin, the index a runner jar carries so that the launcher never has to parse a nested archive's central directory at startup.
    IndexWriter
    Builds the bytes of MICRONAUT-INF/index.bin from a description of the jars and entries a runner jar contains.
    IndexWriter.EntrySpec
    One entry that physically exists in a jar.
    IndexWriter.JarSpec
    One jar of the index: the application layer, or a nested dependency.
    IndexWriter.Layout
    A laid out index: every record in its final position, the hash table filled and the string table built, waiting only for the offsets.
    IndexWriter.PackageSpec
    One package override section, taken from a Name: <package>/ section of a jar's manifest.
    Inspect
    The inspect mode: prints, in a form a human reads, what a runner jar says about itself.
    Launcher
    The Main-Class of every runner jar.
    ListEntries
    The list mode: prints every logical name the archive resolves, and where each one comes from.
    MicronautRunnerJar
    Packages the application and its dependencies into a runner jar.
    MicronautRunnerPlugin
    Packages a Micronaut application as a runner jar: one executable archive in which every dependency remains an intact nested jar.
    NestedJarEntry
    One entry of a NestedJarFile, built from an index record instead of from a central directory header.
    NestedJarFile
    A JarFile view of one nested jar of a runner archive, served entirely from the index.
    PackageMojo
    Packages a Micronaut application as a runner jar: one executable archive in which every dependency remains an intact nested jar.
    RunnerClassLoader
    The class loader that serves an application straight out of its runner jar.
    RunnerJarBuilder
    Turns an application's own output and its resolved dependencies into a runner jar.
    RunnerJarReader
    Opens a finished runner jar with the launcher's own reader.
    RunnerJarResult
    What RunnerJarBuilder.build(RunnerJarSpec, BuildLogger) produced.
    RunnerJarSpec
    Everything RunnerJarBuilder needs to know to produce a runner jar.
    RunnerJarSpec.Builder
    Describes a runner jar step by step.
    RunnerJarURLConnection
    A connection to an entry of a runner archive, served from the index and the memory mapped archive.
    StartupBenchmark
    The end-to-end startup benchmark: builds the sample application in every packaging the runner competes with, starts each of them many times, and reports how long each takes to answer its first request.
    ZipEntryInfo
    An immutable description of one entry of a ZIP archive, as the packaging library needs it.
    ZipReader
    A read-only view of an existing .jar or .zip file, parsed by hand rather than through ZipFile.
    ZipRepacker
    Rewrites a dependency jar so that every entry is STORED, or copies it byte for byte, and reports where each entry's data ended up.
    ZipRepacker.RepackResult
    What a repack or a verbatim copy produced.
    ZipWriter
    A minimal ZIP writer that only ever writes STORED entries and reports the absolute offset of every entry's data as it goes.
